cases.control: the page offers Wishlist, Pull List and Following
an empty account shows an empty state with a way to add
four wants added through the form (comic, card product, toy, older undated piece)
planned total counts known prices times quantities and counts the unpriced one separately
the undated, unpriced piece says Date unknown and Price unknown (not today, not $0)
the card product shows its release window
nothing was invented for the undated piece: no date, window or price stored
category-specific details (era, maker) were kept for the older piece
trading-card fields appear for a card product only (the toy has none)
the Pull List groups by month and window, and leaves the undated piece off
Preordered is recorded by the person (one tap) and can be undone
the page says Preordered is your own arrangement and VLTD placed no order
Preordered can be undone back to Wanted
Skip keeps the record but takes it off the open list
a skipped want no longer counts toward the planned total
a skipped want stays skipped after a reload
